ds.description: 행정안전부 주관 범정부 통합 디자인 시스템. Government Blue #256EF4, Pretendard GOV, WCAG/KWCAG 2.2 a11y-first tokens and components.

tokens.note: Canonical tokens are limited to official KRDS pages with current live capture or still-fresh 2026-05 official-document evidence. Unreverified card, toggle, tab, toast, and floating-button candidates remain prose-only and are not exposed as machine tokens.
